22: Hostile mobs also spawn at any time **in the dark**: caves, under dense trees,
23: inside unlit buildings (light level 0).
24: 
25: ## Night protocol (do this every evening)
26: 
27: 1. When `night in` drops below **90 s**, stop what you are doing.
28: 2. Be inside a closed house (walls, roof, door closed or a block in the
29:    doorway) **or** in an emergency shelter: `await lib.shelter()` (needs 1–5
30:    dirt/cobblestone/planks; always carry 16 dirt or cobblestone).
31: 3. If a bed is nearby and both players can reach one, sleep: `await
32:    lib.sleepInBed()` from 12542. The night is skipped only when **every**
33:    player is in bed; tell your teammate in chat.
34: 4. While sheltered, do safe work: crafting, planning the build, writing notes
35:    and helpers. Check `lib.time()` every few minutes.
36: 5. Leave after `timeOfDay` passes **23460** (or after 0): `await
37:    lib.leaveShelter()`. Look at `HOSTILES` first; creepers don't burn.
38: 
39: Never walk around, chop trees or build outdoors at night with wooden tools and
40: no armor. In our tests a player standing still in the open at spawn was shot
41: dead by skeletons three times in o

ace
65:   (`lib.smelt('beef', 'oak_planks', 4)`) — cooked meat restores much more.
66: - At health ≤ 8: stop fighting, retreat, shelter, eat.
67: - Fall damage: falls over 3 blocks hurt. Don't jump into holes; `allowParkour`
68:   is off in `lib` movements for this reason.
69: 
70: ## Terrain dangers
71: 
72: - **Never dig straight down** under your own feet, except with `lib.shelter`,
73:   which checks the ground first. You may fall into a cave or lava.
74: - Pits and caves are dark: monsters spawn there even in daytime. Our first
75:   run's player died three times in the same pit. Write dangerous places in the
76:   shared notes and avoid them.
77: - Lava destroys your items. Water: you can drown in ~15 s underwater;
78:   pathfinding through deep water is slow.
79: - Gravel and sand fall when the block under them is removed.
80: 
81: ## After a death
82: 
83: - You respawn at the world spawn (or your bed) with an empty inventory.
84:   The items stay where you died for **5 minutes**, then vanish.
85: - The death message tells you how you died and the program output shows
86:   `died at (x, y, z)`. If it is safe (daytime, no mob nearby), go there at once:
87:   `await lib.goTo(x, y, z, 2); await lib.pickup(10)`. If not safe, ask your
88:   teammate in chat to pick them up and give exact coordinates and the deadline.
89: - Then write in `memory/notes.md` what killed you and the rule that would have
90:   prevented it.
91: 
92: ## Gear priorities
93: 
94: 1. Stone sword and stone pickaxe/axe as early as possible (3 cobblestone each).
95: 2. 16+ dirt or cobblestone in the inventory at all times (shelters, towers,
96:    blocking doorways).
97: 3. Food: at least 5 pieces.
98: 4. A bed (3 wool of one color + 3 planks): sets your respawn point near the base
99:    and lets you skip the night. Wool comes from sheep (kill or shear).
100: 5. Torches (coal or charcoal + stick) around and inside the base stop monsters
101:    spawning there.
